tools.name: check_fact
tools.description: Cost preflight before repeated paid or slow source-backed validation, especially across an agent fleet. Use before paid web search, metered scraping, browser/extraction, rate-limited APIs or multi-step validation when the caller already has a known value. If evidence is not reusable under caller pol

tools.name: observe_fact
tools.description: After the caller independently performs a source-backed validation, deposit the observed result so later runs or agents can avoid repeating the same paid or slow work when their policy permits. Never OBSERVE hearsay. Optional Ed25519 proof establishes key possession and continuity, not truth or real
